preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split()[0] == 'YES' if '24' in stdout.split() else True
postconditions.description: If the first line is 'YES', the output must contain '24' as the result of the last operation.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 5 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) if stdout.split()[0] == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: Each operation line must contain exactly five elements: two numbers, an operator, an equals sign, and the result.

postconditions.expression: all(line.split()[2] in ['+', '-', '*'] for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) if stdout.split()[0] == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: The operator in each operation line must be either '+', '-', or '*'.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(int(line.split()[4])) <= 10**18 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) if stdout.split()[0] == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: The absolute value of the result in each operation line must not exceed 10^18.
